BEST HOTEL
💯🩷🧡💛💚💙🩵💜🤎 …

Wonderful!! The professionals deserve a 1000/10 rating, from the receptionists to the veterinarians and monitors. My dog ​​(daughter) was very well taken care of during my 30-day trip!! I highly recommend this hotel.

I really enjoyed RioPet Gávea. I was very well received, the staff is polite and attentive, and you can tell how much they care and treat the animals. The environment is pleasant and inspires confidence. It was a very positive experience.
A unique place, my pets love it, they adore going to daycare, the staff is top-notch.

The experience was terrible. I left my puppy for a 2-day stay, and he was perfectly fine, healthy, and happy. When I picked him up, he had a wound on his testicles, which they claimed was just a small scrape. He was very lethargic and licking the wound. The only thing they did was apply a human diaper rash cream. Seeing my pet's suffering, I took him to the emergency room that same day, where they diagnosed the wound and inflammation, and he also had intestinal gas, which he had never had before. I paid a fortune for the treatment, which will take a week to treat the infection, and the worst part is seeing my pet suffer. Run away, run far away, from Riopet.

Just wanted to express my sincere gratitude to the RioPet team for their work. It was sensational. We always felt very reassured leaving Noli and Basquiat with you, especially for 15 days straight. Thank you for taking such good care of them when they vomited in the first few days! You guys are fantastic and competent in what you do. We have complete confidence in you, and the dogs love you!
High level of professionalism at this pet daycare/hotel. To give you an idea, they create a group with daily updates for all family members.
A really cool place to leave your pet, with great staff who truly love pets.

Great place to stay or spend the day!
The experience of leaving our dog there for 10 days was very good!
Very attentive staff, perfect environment for pets.
Wonderful, the communication from the team is excellent, and the transport with Wallace is perfect. My dog ​​comes back super happy!

My dog ​​loves this place and I love that I can trust it completely! When he sees Uncle Walace's car, he already knows, haha. On daycare days, he wakes me up even earlier! The staff is very well trained!

We love this hotel too! Our dog is crazy about it and just knowing he's going makes him so excited 🐶 He comes back happy and so tired that he's exhausted for two days 😂 The service is excellent, with a caring, attentive team that truly loves animals. I highly recommend it! …
Riopet is amazing. A wonderful place for our pets, and the staff are caring and affectionate. My Indiana Jones loved his stay. I highly recommend it!
Riopet is the best dog hotel in Rio! I've been a customer for years and wouldn't trade it for anything!
Excellent accommodation, everything was organized, I was able to travel and have the peace of mind knowing my dog ​​was very well looked after.
My dog ​​loves the local activities, and I feel reassured knowing he's being very well cared for.

Wonderful place; everyone treats all the animals with great care and love.
My pet son is called Toddy, he loves going to Rio Pet Gávea, thank you for everything.
I highly recommend it!!! Wonderful facilities and sensational staff!

I love this place! Every time we travel, I leave my dogs there and they are treated with great care. They stay once a week, get a bath, and have all their vaccinations checked. It's a complete service, I recommend it to everyone.
Our dog always comes back from there happy and healthy.
Amazing place to leave your pet, I trust them 100%! Very professional and with immense love for animals. Incredible and very welcoming team, I highly recommend them!!

Simply incredible. The place looks like a resort, a breathtaking structure, super complete, with air conditioning, all activities controlled by the staff, beds to sleep in, food organization, etc. The location is surrounded by nature. Wonderful.

If you're looking for a reliable place where professionalism comes first, then run away from here. I want to register my dissatisfaction with the service provided by this establishment, especially regarding the charges and the lack of transparency in customer service.

When I left my pet in the care of this establishment, I expected an organized service, with clear communication and conditions commensurate with the price charged. However, throughout the experience, I felt cheated and deceived, mainly because the final charge did not match what was initially informed and discussed BY PHONE, since they did not respond via WhatsApp. This situation caused surprise and discomfort! Therefore, don't do anything without it being written down and VERY clear, because there are establishments that act in bad faith, taking advantage of the turbulent times during these holidays!

I booked my son's pet's stay for the New Year's period. I already knew they would "rip you off," since we were very close to the 31st and there weren't many pet boarding options available. I requested a stay for the 31st and 1st of January, but they told me that the pet would have to stay an extra day at the facility (before the agreed date) for "adaptation" (6 hours at the facility) and would be charged a fee of R$80.00. If he was fine, he could return for the two days requested. We then scheduled the adaptation for the 30th. I asked if the pet could stay continuously, in case he adapted, just so he wouldn't have to go back home and then back again the next day (the traffic in Copacabana, where the pet lives, is chaotic at that time of year) and I asked how much they would charge. The person who answered me ON THE PHONE (ALANA) told me that in that case they would charge the daily rate (which is absurdly R$247.00) minus the adaptation fee! I thought it was fair, since it wouldn't be a planned day for him (Chico, the pet) to go. In that case, I would pay R$167.00 on the first day. I added everything up and paid in advance!

What a surprise it was when they sent me the total bill and they were charging for the entire 3 days!! When I argued, Alana herself told me that to deduct the assessment fee, I would have had to pay for it. So she meant that IN ADDITION to the first day's fee (which would be the adaptation period, which we hadn't anticipated) I would have to pay for the assessment, and then deduct it!! Hahahaha - just laughing!!). BUT THE AGREEMENT WAS TO DEDUCT THE FIRST DAY'S ASSESSMENT FEE, which became a full day's fee!!!!
In addition to the daily fee, I paid for some vaccines that were necessary for Chico's stay, for the round-trip taxi, and for the bath! Imagine the fortune, for a place that was so-so...

They only sent a few photos and 1 video once a day, and I was shocked by the number of pets... I didn't see him eating, bathing, or getting the vaccines I requested...
And to top it all off, this employee argues all the time! She's always arguing and doesn't acknowledge her mistake! They don't know how to deal with customers... that's why they've already lost one!

These factors, combined, caused insecurity and frustration, especially since it involved the care of a pet, which requires trust, attention, and clear information. NEVER AGAIN to that place! They've lost all trust!
